label: OpenAI
agentGuide: Base path /v1. Chat: POST /chat/completions {"model": "gpt-4o-mini", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]} (choices[0].message.content); structured: add "response_format": {"type": "json_object"}. Models: GET /models. Embeddings: POST /embeddings {"model": "text-embedding-3-small", "input": "..."}. Images: POST /images/generations {"model": "gpt-image-1", "prompt": "...", "size": "1024x1024"} (b64_json; use save_as on the data). Speech: POST /audio/speech {"model": "gpt-4o-mini-tts", "voice": "alloy", "input": "..."} (binary mp3, save_as). Transcription needs a multipart upload, which this relay does not send. Every call is billed to the key: keep prompts tight. The key is set by Allkin.
